required_work: Give the maintained product's sensing lane a canonical home as a distinct automation family under the existing automation discipline, and prove the two families never merge into one implied capability.
objective: The operability owner describes automation families that sense the institution itself. The two-mode composition canon accepts a second activation lane driven by signals from the maintained product, and nothing in the operability owner says where that sensing lives. Add one bounded family under the identical automation spec and discipline — observe and propose only, typed freshness-bounded findings, corrections only through admitted paths, honest coverage — and prove by construction that institution-plane assurance and product-plane sensing stay separate objects with separate coverage, so neither is ever read as evidence for the other. PRODUCT_SIGNAL_SENSING_AUTOMATION_FAMILY_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: The maintained product's sensing lane is a distinct automation family carrying the same spec, the same observe-and-propose limit, and its own coverage; no projection, receipt, or coverage statement lets a finding from one family satisfy an obligation of the other.
selected_profile: The selected single-node deployment's automation plane: the assurance family that senses the institution, and the product-signal family this record adds.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

current_implementation_evidence: EXTRACTED OBLIGATION, CANON HALF STILL OPEN. Verified at 7ee7acc2e: the operability owner contains no product-plane sensing family and no wording distinguishing it from institution-plane assurance. Unlike the other obligations extracted in the same pass, this one has not landed in canon either, so the record owns a canon addition and its program consequence together.
The two-mode composition is accepted canon and cited by two existing records, so the second activation lane is admitted doctrine with no sensing owner named for it.
in_scope: One bounded addition to the operability owner: the maintained-product sensing family, declared under the identical automation spec and rules — observe and propose only, typed findings with an explicit freshness bound, corrections only through admitted paths, and coverage stated honestly including where it is absent.

The separation rule, written where a reader of either family will see it: the two families are distinct objects with distinct coverage, and a finding in one never discharges an obligation of the other.

The program consequence: the family's typed finding shape and its freshness bound expressed wherever automation specs are declared, with a negative case proving a finding with no freshness bound is refused.
A statement of what the family does NOT sense, so its coverage claim is bounded on the day it is written.
out_of_scope: Building any sensor, collector, or evidence pipeline. This names a family and its discipline; it collects nothing.
Admitting external evidence providers. Consuming an observability system as an admitted evidence source belongs to the connector path, not here.
Changing the assurance family. Its spec, rules, and coverage are unchanged, and this record must not widen them.
Any claim about the maintained product's health. A family with no sensors senses nothing.
positive_proof: The operability owner declares the product-signal family, its discipline, and the separation rule; a declared spec in the new family validates; and the retained literal appears exactly once.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Predeclared refusals: a finding carrying no freshness bound; a finding whose freshness bound has elapsed presented as current; a spec in the new family that declares a corrective action outside an admitted path; a coverage statement that counts assurance-family findings toward product-plane coverage or the reverse; a projection that renders the two families as one capability; a family declared with no statement of what it does not sense.

The baseline is the current silence: with no family declared, a product-plane finding today has no home, no freshness contract, and no coverage boundary, so the first one produced would arrive with none of them.

code_anchors.evidence_scope: the owner that carries the assurance family today and contains no product-plane sensing family; the silence is this record's baseline, not its proof

remaining_nonclaims: Declaring a family is not sensing. Nothing here observes the maintained product, and closing this record produces no finding about any product.
The separation rule is a construction rule, not a guarantee that a reader will not conflate the two families in prose written elsewhere.
This record closes no stage, grants no capability, and publishes no claim.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop if the family cannot be declared without either widening the assurance family's rules or introducing a new primitive, plane, or rail. The addition is one family under the existing spec; if it will not fit there, the honest outcome is a named canon gap taken to the owner, never a second automation discipline.
exit_criteria: The owner declares the family, its discipline, its bounded coverage, and the separation rule; every predeclared refusal fires by name; and the retained literal appears exactly once.
